## What's Changed
### Dependencies
* Bump golang.org/x/net from 0.33.0 to 0.36.0 in the go_modules group by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/fullstorydev/grpcurl/pull/511
* Bump google.golang.org/protobuf from 1.36.5 to 1.36.6 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/fullstorydev/grpcurl/pull/515
* Bump golang.org/x/net from 0.36.0 to 0.38.0 in the go_modules group by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/fullstorydev/grpcurl/pull/517
* Bump golang.org/x/oauth2 from 0.14.0 to 0.27.0 in the go_modules group by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/fullstorydev/grpcurl/pull/520
* Bump google.golang.org/protobuf from 1.36.6 to 1.36.7 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/fullstorydev/grpcurl/pull/525
* Bump google.golang.org/protobuf from 1.36.7 to 1.36.8 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/fullstorydev/grpcurl/pull/527
* Bump google.golang.org/protobuf from 1.36.8 to 1.36.10 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/fullstorydev/grpcurl/pull/535
* Bump github.com/jhump/protoreflect from 1.17.0 to 1.18.0 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/fullstorydev/grpcurl/pull/545
* Bump golang.org/x/net from 0.49.0 to 0.55.0 in the go_modules group across 1 directory by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/fullstorydev/grpcurl/pull/569
* Bump google.golang.org/protobuf from 1.36.11 to 1.36.12 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/fullstorydev/grpcurl/pull/576
### Changes
* snap by @PietroPasotti in https://github.com/fullstorydev/grpcurl/pull/512
* Set GOWORK=off and GOPATHS=-trimpath when building by @gpassini in https://github.com/fullstorydev/grpcurl/pull/513
* Restore Unix socket support by @zhyuri in https://github.com/fullstorydev/grpcurl/pull/498
* Snap: strict confinement, stable grade and docs by @PietroPasotti in https://github.com/fullstorydev/grpcurl/pull/514
* test: Update TLS error checks for Go 1.25 compatibility by @mikelolasagasti in https://github.com/fullstorydev/grpcurl/pull/522
* feat: add arm snap build by @PietroPasotti in https://github.com/fullstorydev/grpcurl/pull/534
* refactor: use slices.Contains to simplify code by @vastonus in https://github.com/fullstorydev/grpcurl/pull/536
* refactor: use strings.Builder to improve performance by @rifeplight in https://github.com/fullstorydev/grpcurl/pull/537
* update lead version to Go 1.25 by @dragonsinth in https://github.com/fullstorydev/grpcurl/pull/543
* Add Windows Arm64 release by @kpreisser in https://github.com/fullstorydev/grpcurl/pull/542
* refactor: remove obsolete // +build tag by @cuoguojida in https://github.com/fullstorydev/grpcurl/pull/560
* Bump google.golang.org/grpc to v1.79.3 (CVE-2026-33186 + 3 transitive CVEs) by @shreyas-sriram in https://github.com/fullstorydev/grpcurl/pull/559
* Bump google.golang.org/grpc from 1.66.2 to 1.80.0 by @olegbonar in https://github.com/fullstorydev/grpcurl/pull/556
* Add support for TLS 1.3 by @bcleenders in https://github.com/fullstorydev/grpcurl/pull/564
* Fast-fail on connection errors by @bcleenders in https://github.com/fullstorydev/grpcurl/pull/567
* fix xds credentials being silently ignored by @erikjoh in https://github.com/fullstorydev/grpcurl/pull/566
* docs: fix typo "foor" -> "foo" in README example by @maxtaran2010 in https://github.com/fullstorydev/grpcurl/pull/571
* Fix flaky TLS test by waiting for dial outcome before closing connection by @bcleenders in https://github.com/fullstorydev/grpcurl/pull/572
* Fix path traversal attack in `-proto-out-dir` by @bcleenders in https://github.com/fullstorydev/grpcurl/pull/573
* remove old SA1019 lint:ignore by @dragonsinth in https://github.com/fullstorydev/grpcurl/pull/574
* go mod update by @dragonsinth in https://github.com/fullstorydev/grpcurl/pull/578
* remove old SA1019 lint:ignore by @dragonsinth in https://github.com/fullstorydev/grpcurl/pull/577
* fix: preserve wrapped request and descriptor errors by @ginavalent in https://github.com/fullstorydev/grpcurl/pull/579
* update release to cut and upload via gh actions by @SamKirsch10 in https://github.com/fullstorydev/grpcurl/pull/580
